wrong_controls.name: WC3_law_derived_from_data_not_first_principles
wrong_controls.details: Law v1.0 was derived inductively by inspecting BOUND_COLOR_PAIR cluster centers in CR127.  In-sample verification confirms the rule is CONSISTENT with the training set; CR128_PRED_1 commits the rule for FORWARD-BLIND testing on future rows where overfit cannot operate.  Honest WC: in-sample 100% match does not prove first-principles derivation, only generator consistency.

wrong_controls.name: WC4_S_debit_formula_intentionally_NOT_claimed
wrong_controls.details: Doublet splitting at +/- S_debit is observed in every (a,b) / (b,a) pair but its amplitude formula is left to CR128b.  Claiming the splitting formula here without separate derivation would overpromise.

wrong_controls.name: WC5_symmetric_pair_M_obs_explicitly_out_of_scope
wrong_controls.details: Symmetric (a,a) pairs match the M_native formula but their M_observed is shifted by a non-trivial debit (M_obs(a,a) ~ 10.75 * a^2 = (43/4) * a^2).  CR128 covers M_native only; M_observed structure for symmetric pairs is separate work.

wrong_controls.name: WC6_OCTET_COMPOSITE_numerical_coincidences_noted
wrong_controls.details: Several OCTET_COMPOSITE 3-body clusters in CR127 land at the same numerical mass as 2-body pair predictions (e.g. cluster 16 at 132 MeV = (1,9)).  This is a numerical coincidence -- 3-body generator is not the same as 2-body.  OCTET_COMPOSITE law derivation is separate CR129+ work.

wrong_controls.name: WC7_algebra_extension_path_documented
wrong_controls.details: If the partition algebra is ever extended (e.g. adding 5, 7, 10, 11), each new element generates additional pairs.  CR128 v1.0 is locked against the current algebra {1,2,3,4,6,8,9,12}; algebra extension warrants an appeal CR, not a violation of v1.0.
